purpose: Propose and validate INSURANCE-AS-A-GATE overall-score formulas, fixing the compensatory failure overall_score_validation.py found in Option B. Same validation suite, so naive / Option B / every gate candidate are directly comparable.
scope: Analysis only. No production code or artifact modified.
insurance_third_definition: mean of three 0/100 indicators — insurance_tier == Covered, income_protection_coverage, hospitalisation_coverage — used ONLY as a gate signal, never as an addend

ceiling_grounding.values_39_69_100: the project's own historical TIER_THRESHOLDS (0-39 At Risk / 40-69 Building / 70-100 Stable). The mechanism they belonged to is superseded but the boundaries are the only banding this project has ever written down.
ceiling_grounding.zero_coverage_must_not_read_as_stable: follows directly from the brief's stated principle that critical gaps surface regardless of overall score
ceiling_grounding.JUDGEMENT_CALL_no_independent_grounding: the MAPPING from indicators-missing to which ceiling applies. Run at three harshness settings (lenient / band_ladder / strict) and reported as a sensitivity rather than presented as the answer.
ceiling_grounding.multiplicative_floor_0.5: PURE JUDGEMENT CALL. Nothing in this project supports 'zero insurance halves your score'. The weakest-grounded number here.

c_optionb_capped[lenient].gates_what: Option B's own score (10 possible values before capping)
